## Patterns

- [Patterns](patterns/README.md) — Reusable section-level structures for professional writing, prompts, and document design.
- [BLUF Pattern](patterns/bluf.md) — A compact structure that puts the answer, recommendation, or ask in the first sentence.
- [Context / Analysis / Options / Recommendation](patterns/context-analysis-options-recommendation.md) — A decision-support pattern for comparing options fairly before recommending one.
- [Decision / Rationale / Consequences](patterns/decision-rationale-consequences.md) — A concise record pattern for documenting what was decided, why, and what follows.
- [Issue / Risk / Control / Owner / Date](patterns/issue-risk-control-owner-date.md) — A compact risk and control pattern for audit, governance, and remediation tracking.
- [Objective / Scope / Procedure / Exceptions](patterns/objective-scope-procedure-exceptions.md) — A procedure pattern for SOPs, runbooks, policies, and repeatable operating guidance.
- [Problem / Impact / Recommendation / Next Steps](patterns/problem-impact-recommendation-next-steps.md) — A practical escalation and proposal pattern for moving from issue to action.
- [Situation / Complication / Question / Answer](patterns/situation-complication-question-answer.md) — A consulting-style narrative pattern for moving from context to a clear recommendation.
- [What / So What / Now What](patterns/what-so-what-now-what.md) — A simple pattern for turning facts into meaning and action.
